description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420201 (23/0591)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations regarding title to specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, and other property-related details, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
